prompts.name: 搭档库
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished desktop visual-novel game UI design reference, wide landscape 16:9, approximately 1672x941. This is a redesign of the interface in reference image 1, saved as a separate new mockup, NOT an implementation screenshot. Image 1 is the existing Aurora Forge home UI style and background/AF-logo reference: preserve its sunny campus library background, refined Chinese typography, small white AF orbital logo upper-left, glasslike neutral dark-gray rectangular panels, thin pale borders, small lower-right chamfered corners, restrained cyan highlights, and spacious composition. Completely replace the home menu with the specified character-management page. Image 2 is the exact Aurore sprite to composite, not a black rectangle: preserve her silver-blue long hair, blue eyes, cyan triangular hair clip, white jacket over navy shirt and pleated skirt, dark tights and black shoes, same face, anatomy and existing pose. Keep the character an independent visual-novel standing sprite, never redraw as a scene CG or embed a separate black background behind her. Background should remain visible through panels, comparable to dark neutral gray at about 55% opacity. No emoji, no battle stats, no stars, rarity, currency, gacha, hearts or numeric affection meters, no combat equipment, no fabricated memories. Do not copy the logos or exact UI of Arknights, Blue Archive or Reverse1999; use only their hierarchy, character-card appeal and dossier clarity within AF's established palette. All interface text in crisp legible Simplified Chinese except the name Aurore and the existing AF logo. Render only one complete interface, no multi-screen collage, no device frame, no callouts outside the interface.
PAGE 1: CHARACTER LIBRARY, the default entry from home. Top-left after the AF logo show a back arrow and large title "搭档档案". Beneath, a horizontal filter strip "全部" active with cyan underline, then "预置搭档", "我的搭档". Upper-right provide a restrained dark search field "搜索搭档", an outlined import button "导入", and cyan primary button "+ 新建搭档".
Main body is a roomy roster of tall portrait cards, not horizontal save slots or a large hero outside the grid. Show three cards in one row, each about 300-340px wide and 520px tall, with generous gaps, starting around x=80,y=235. Card 1 is selected with a single clean cyan border and a 20px lower-right chamfer; put a cropped upper-body view of the EXACT Aurore sprite inside this card, same independent sprite treatment, transparent over the library setting. Footer of card 1 dark neutral panel: large "Aurore", small "AF 原创搭档", discreet tag "预置", and a small ellipsis management control. Card 2 is a saved custom-template draft, neutral gray outline portrait-placeholder icon (not an additional illustrated person), title "未命名搭档", tags "自设" and "草稿", small text "补充设定与立绘". Card 3 is an understated dashed-line creation card with a large plus, title "新建搭档", small "从一个想法开始". Leave the rest of the library open and uncluttered, without fake locked or numbered slots. No secondary large Aurore figure on the background, no duplicated full-size character, no details form yet. Cards should feel like collectible character portraits but function as a user's editable companion library.

PAGE 2: SELECTED COMPANION DOSSIER. Top-left keep AF and back arrow, title "搭档档案"; small breadcrumb "搭档库 / Aurore". Right 52% from x~760,y~155 to near bottom is a broad translucent dark-gray dossier panel with subtle chamfered corners. Along its top use tabs "人物档案" active cyan underline, "相处设定", "外观资源", "故事记录". The active page should read like a refined character dossier rather than a dense settings form: short sections with fine divider rules and generous spacing.
Show heading "关于 Aurore". Display "来源  AF 原创搭档" and "背景  现实校园" in a compact two-column info row. Then section "性格与表达" with an unobtrusive "设定示例" tag and the short editable example text "温和、好奇，愿意一起寻找答案。" Then section "知识范围" with "依据自身经历、被告知与实际查阅的内容回应。" A lower small section "档案说明" says "相同搭档在不同故事中的经历分别保存。"
Bottom-right within the panel has secondary outlined "编辑搭档" and larger cyan primary "以她开始新故事 →". Beneath them one small muted line "模板修改不覆盖已有故事". Do not show progress bars, relationship scores or invented shared history; no stat grids. This should clearly communicate that this is a character template's reading view, while Story Records is a separate tab.

PAGE 3: COMPANION EDITOR. Top-left AF logo, back arrow, title "编辑搭档"; small breadcrumb "搭档库 / Aurore / 编辑". Left 34% displays the same EXACT full-body Aurore sprite as a persistent live preview, with complete head and feet within frame. Under the preview put a small neutral label "立绘预览" and a restrained outlined button "更换中性立绘". Do not replace Aurore with another character.
Right 59%, x~640,y~145, is a large translucent dark-gray edit form panel with chamfered edges, precise alignment, clear large text and minimal controls. A small top tag "搭档模板 · 副本". Use two-column form rows: "搭档姓名" value "Aurore 的副本", beside "来源类型" dropdown value "原创 / 自设"; next row "搭档身份" value "同校的伙伴", beside "用户身份" value "大学生". Then a full-width textarea label "人物设定", filled with short example "温和、好奇，愿意在日常交流中一起寻找答案。" with a modest "设定示例" indicator. Next row "现实背景" dropdown value "现实校园", beside "对用户的称呼" an empty input with placeholder "未指定时使用自然称呼". Inputs must be dark translucent rectangles with fine pale borders, not bright white rounded SaaS fields. Below show a collapsed row "高级设定" with a chevron and small subtext "语言习惯、知识范围、关系起点与主动性". Add a neat resource status row "中性立绘  已添加" with a tiny outlined check icon; no synthetic speech controls.
An anchored footer contains small explanatory text "只修改此模板，已有故事不受影响。" and right-aligned actions "取消", outlined "保存草稿", cyan primary "保存搭档". This page should visibly be the edit state paired with the dossier, not a different application skin. No full prompt editor, no technical API/schema fields, no extra character, no numerical intimacy controls.
